capabilities: pin commands, files, and web links as one-click Ribbon buttons
create group buttons that open pop-up menus
reorder pins by dragging and customize tooltips and icons
use Lucide icons or custom .svg files from an icon folder
set where pinned files open (new tab, current tab, split)
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
problem: Obsidian's Ribbon offers no built-in way to pin arbitrary commands, files, or web links or to organize them into grouped menus.
summary: Ribbon organizer that pins commands, files, and web links as one-click buttons or groups them into pop-up menus on Obsidian's Ribbon.
